channel.title: The Times of Israel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Times of Israel (timesofisrael.com)

item.title: Syria deploys thousands of troops to border with Lebanon, officials say
item.description: Move aimed at preventing smuggling of arms, drugs and to block Hezbollah from infiltrating, Syrian officers say, after Iran-backed terror group attacked Israel in support of Tehran The post Syria deploys thousands of troops to border with Lebanon, officials say appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Israel partially evacuates UAE embassy staff after 2 attempted Iranian terror attacks — official
item.description: Foreign Ministry says officials working to determine 'safest paths of return' for Israelis in the Gulf state, which pushes back on report it's planning to join strikes on Iran The post Israel partially evacuates UAE embassy staff after 2 attempted Iranian terror attacks — official appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: IDF says it destroyed secret underground site where Iran moved nuclear project after June war
item.description: Israeli jets have dropped over 4,000 munitions on Islamic Republic in four days of US-Israeli bombing campaign, more than in all 12 days of previous war, according to the military The post IDF says it destroyed secret underground site where Iran moved nuclear project after June war appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: IDF carries out ‘broad wave of attacks’ across Iran overnight; Iranian missiles lobbed at Israel
item.description: Report says that ahead of Saturday strike, Netanyahu phoned Trump to say Khamenei would convene his top advisers that day * Lebanon says several killed in Israeli strikes as IDF and Hezbollah trade fire The post IDF carries out ‘broad wave of attacks’ across Iran overnight; Iranian missiles lobbed at Israel appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Hezbollah fires on Tel Aviv as Israel threatens Iranian officers in Lebanon
item.description: Terror group carries out first long-range attack since start of Iran war; IDF says 'no safe place' for Iranian regime in Lebanon The post Hezbollah fires on Tel Aviv as Israel threatens Iranian officers in Lebanon appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US State Department helping almost 500 Americans seeking to evacuate from Israel
item.description: With commercial options limited, assistant secretary of state says US 'actively securing military aircraft and charter flights for American citizens who wish to leave' the region The post US State Department helping almost 500 Americans seeking to evacuate from Israel appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Macron orders French aircraft carrier to Mediterranean to protect allied assets in region
item.description: French leader cites strike on UK base in Cyprus as reason for move, says Iran's 'dangerous nuclear program, unprecedented ballistic capabilities' and backing of proxies to blame for war The post Macron orders French aircraft carrier to Mediterranean to protect allied assets in region appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Spurning Pahlavi, Trump says ‘someone from within’ Iran may be better Khamenei successor
item.description: US president says 'most of the people we had in mind' to lead Iranian government are dead already; NYT reports that Khamenei's son has emerged as frontrunner to be new supreme leader The post Spurning Pahlavi, Trump says ‘someone from within’ Iran may be better Khamenei successor appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US officials say diplomatic path was at dead end when Trump approved Iran strikes
item.description: Top Trump officials accuse Iran of trying to drag US along during three rounds of talks, claiming it wouldn't seek a nuclear weapon while insisting on maintaining the means to do so The post US officials say diplomatic path was at dead end when Trump approved Iran strikes appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US in talks with Iranian Kurds on potential CIA-backed op for uprising – sources
item.description: Groups have asked for support; plan would be to take on Iran's security forces in west of country, enabling citizen revolt against regime The post US in talks with Iranian Kurds on potential CIA-backed op for uprising – sources appeared first on The Times of Israel.
